hook.say: Everybody knows the continents. Or do they? Five questions, three seconds each. Go!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.fact: Asia holds about 30% of Earth's land and about 60% of its people.
questions.sayAnswer: Asia! It holds about 30 percent of Earth's land, and about 60 percent of its people.

questions.fact: Australia covers about 7.6 million square km. Asia is almost 6 times bigger.
questions.sayAnswer: Australia! It covers about 7.6 million square kilometers. Asia is almost 6 times bigger.

questions.q: On which continent is the Atacama, the driest non-polar desert?
questions.fact: The Atacama runs along the Pacific coast of northern Chile.
questions.sayAnswer: South America! The Atacama runs along the Pacific coast of northern Chile.

questions.q: Which continent is crossed by both the equator and the prime meridian?
questions.fact: The two lines meet in the Atlantic, just off Africa's west coast.
questions.sayAnswer: Africa! The two lines meet in the Atlantic Ocean, just off Africa's west coast.

questions.q: Which continent holds most of Earth's fresh water?
questions.fact: Antarctica's ice sheet locks up well over half of Earth's fresh water.
questions.sayAnswer: Antarctica! Its ice sheet locks up well over half of all the fresh water on Earth.
